summary: Firewatch entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Firewatch
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release on Steam or GOG

primary.version: Current PC release with free-roam/audio-tour modes documented
primary.why: The PC route has the best capture/settings flexibility for Firewatch's visual and narrative presentation, while later console/Switch ports are useful platform comparisons. The free-roam and audio-tour/post-game modes should be documented if included.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release through Steam or GOG. Record build, storefront, graphics settings, input, subtitles/audio language, free-roam/audio-tour availability, save chapter/day, and whether console/Switch ports were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the best capture route.

all_releases.reason: primary: document if included in archive coverage.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PC release covers the full game; other platforms are comparison routes.
